extracted.intended_audience: U.S. patent applicants and practitioners (attorneys/agents) seeking participation in the USPTO Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program
extracted.subtask_description: Filing the USPTO form/request to participate in the Global/IP5 Patent Prosecution Highway (PPH) pilot program and petitioning to make a U.S. application special under the PPH, including required supporting documents and certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Method of submission
rubrics_metrics.description: THIS REQUEST FOR PARTICIPATION IN THE PPH PILOT PROGRAM ALONG WITH THE REQUIRED DOCUMENTS MUST BE SUBMITTED VIA THE USPTO PATENT ELECTRONIC FILING SYSTEM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information regarding the Patent Electronic Filing System (EFS) is available at https://www.uspto.gov/ebc. Do not send fees or completed forms to the Chief Administrative Officer address shown in the Privacy Act Statement; send filings to the Commissioner for Patents (address shown).

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for participation / petition to make special
rubrics_metrics.description: APPLICANT HEREBY REQUESTS PARTICIPATION IN THE PATENT PROSECUTION HIGHWAY (PPH) PILOT PROGRAM AND PETITIONS TO MAKE THE ABOVE-IDENTIFIED APPLICATION SPECIAL UNDER THE PPH PILOT PROGRAM.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form serves as the applicant's formal request/petition to the USPTO to participate in the PPH pilot program and to have the application advanced for special processing under that program.

rubrics_metrics.name: National stage request under 35 U.S.C. 371 (if applicable)
rubrics_metrics.description: For national stage applications under 35 U.S.C. 371 only: This is an express request to begin national stage processing under 35 U.S.C. 371(f).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: National stage processing will not commence prior to 30 months from the priority date absent an express request to begin national stage processing under 35 U.S.C. 371(f) and fulfillment of the requirements under 35 U.S.C. 371(c)(1), (2), and (4) for payment of the basic national fee, copy of the International Application and English translation thereof (if required), and the oath or declaration of the inventor(s).

rubrics_metrics.name: OEE work product and translation (submission / retrieval)
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of the OEE work product and translation if not already in English: Attached / Previously Submitted / Not required because the decision to grant a patent was the first office action. Applicant requests the USPTO to attempt to obtain the OEE work product from the Dossier Access System or PATENTSCOPE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the applicant requests the USPTO to obtain the OEE work product electronically and such attempt is unsuccessful, the applicant will be required to supply the document. To avoid dismissal of the initial PPH request and potential denial of participation in the PPH program, the applicant should verify that the OEE work product is actually available via the Dossier Access System or PATENTSCOPE before requesting retrieval. If the applicant is unable to verify availability, then the applicant should submit the document with the PPH request.

rubrics_metrics.name: References cited in OEE work product (IDS requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: An information disclosure statement (IDS) listing the references cited in the OEE work product and document copies (except U.S. patents and U.S. published patent applications): Attached / Previously Submitted / Not required because no references were cited in the OEE work product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide copies of the cited non‑U.S. patent literature with the PPH request unless already submitted; indicate if none were cited.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims correspondence certification statement
rubrics_metrics.description: All of the claims in this application sufficiently correspond to the patentable/allowable claims in the OEE application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a required certification by the applicant (or representative) that the U.S. claims correspond to the patentable/allowable claims identified in the OEE work product.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims correspondence table (mapping and explanation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims in U.S. Application / Patentable/Allowable Claims in OEE Application / Explanation Regarding the Correspondence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a table mapping each claim in the U.S. application to the patentable/allowable claim(s) in the OEE application and a written explanation describing how the claims correspond.

rubrics_metrics.name: OEE application and earliest date details
rubrics_metrics.description: Office of earlier examination (OEE): OEE application number: Both the OEE application and the above-identified U.S. application have the following earliest date (filing or priority date): Type of OEE work product relied upon: Mailing date of OEE work product:
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete all OEE identification fields (application number, earliest filing/priority date, type of work product relied upon such as office action or allowance, and mailing date) as part of the PPH request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature and registration information
rubrics_metrics.description: Signature / Name (print or type) / Date / Registration Number.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The request/certification requires a signature and typed/printed name, date, and practitioner registration number where applicable; omission may affect validity of the petition.
